home.heroTitle: Check Your Plant Leaves & Field Health in Seconds.
home.heroSubtitle: Upload one or more photos of your plant, add optional soil or symptom details, and get clear treatment steps and local weather risk.
home.supportedNote: Supports JPG, PNG, and WebP · Single or multiple plant photos · Instant QR Field Passport
home.step1Desc: Upload multiple leaves, front/back undersides, and close-ups of the same plant along with optional soil details and visible symptoms.
home.step2Desc: Each photo is analyzed and combined into one clear diagnosis with affected leaf area measurement and lesion segmentation.
home.step3Desc: Get simple explanations, causes, ICAR/FAO/USDA verified treatments, Open-Meteo weather risk, and plant progression tracking.
home.emptyOutbreak: No regional alerts yet. Screenings with a location appear on the outbreak map.
home.storyProblemTitle: Diseases spread silently days before a farmer notices.
home.storyProblemDesc: Microscopic spores, bacterial lesions, and nutrient imbalances begin on leaf undersides and inner canopies long before visible wilting threatens harvest yield.
home.storyProblemCaption: Early cellular chlorosis and necrotic halos require inspection before canopy-wide loss.

scan.title: Smart Plant & Field Inspection
scan.subtitle: Upload one or more clear photos of the same plant. Extra field details are optional.
scan.plantPhotosHint: Upload multiple angles together or switch to Individual Views for Front, Back (underside), and Close-up photos.

scan.viewBackHint: Leaf underside showing spores or insects
scan.viewCloseupHint: Tight macro shot of spots, lesions, or halos

scan.dropzoneTitle: Drag and drop plant photographs here
scan.dropzoneHint: Supports JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WebP up to 10 MB per photo (same plant only).

scan.signInSaveNote: Sign in to run inspections, link plant progression records, and store reports privately under your account.

scan.uncertainTitle: Uncertain or Mixed Evidence — Please Verify

scan.noChemicalOnUncertain: Chemical fungicide/pesticide names are intentionally withheld when diagnosis evidence is uncertain. Submit clearer photos or consult a KVK pathologist.

monitoring.title: Plant Monitoring & Disease Progression

expert.title: Expert Verification Portal
expert.portalSubtitle: Authenticated agricultural pathologists review privacy-scrubbed screenings and manage platform governance.
expert.expertOnlyNote: Restricted to approved Agricultural Experts and System Administrators.
expert.farmerBlockedNote: Signed in as Farmer ({{email}}). Farmer accounts do not have verification privileges; sign in with an Expert or Admin account here.
expert.rbacPoint1: Farmer accounts cannot self-register as Experts. Only CLI provisioning or an Administrator can create Expert credentials.
expert.rbacPoint2: Farmer personal identifiers (emails/private account details) are scrubbed from the expert review queue.
expert.rbacPoint3: Every Expert confirmation or correction preserves the original AI prediction alongside the verified label.
